import chess

# Construct FEN from the piece positions
# White: Kg1, Qd7, Ra5, Ba3, Nh4, Pf2, Pg2, Ph2
# Black: Kh8, Qg6, Nb7, Pf7, Pg7, Ph7
# White to move

# Let's build the board manually
board = chess.Board("8/5q1k/1n6/3Q4/8/8/8/6K1 w - - 0 1")  # This is wrong, let me do it properly

# Actually, let me place pieces correctly
board = chess.Board.empty()

# White pieces
board.set_piece_at(chess.G1, chess.Piece(chess.KING, chess.WHITE))
board.set_piece_at(chess.D7, chess.Piece(chess.QUEEN, chess.WHITE))
board.set_piece_at(chess.A5, chess.Piece(chess.ROOK, chess.WHITE))
board.set_piece_at(chess.A3, chess.Piece(chess.BISHOP, chess.WHITE))
board.set_piece_at(chess.H4, chess.Piece(chess.KNIGHT, chess.WHITE))
board.set_piece_at(chess.F2, chess.Piece(chess.PAWN, chess.WHITE))
board.set_piece_at(chess.G2, chess.Piece(chess.PAWN, chess.WHITE))
board.set_piece_at(chess.H2, chess.Piece(chess.PAWN, chess.WHITE))

# Black pieces
board.set_piece_at(chess.H8, chess.Piece(chess.KING, chess.BLACK))
board.set_piece_at(chess.G6, chess.Piece(chess.QUEEN, chess.BLACK))
board.set_piece_at(chess.B7, chess.Piece(chess.KNIGHT, chess.BLACK))
board.set_piece_at(chess.F7, chess.Piece(chess.PAWN, chess.BLACK))
board.set_piece_at(chess.G7, chess.Piece(chess.PAWN, chess.BLACK))
board.set_piece_at(chess.H7, chess.Piece(chess.PAWN, chess.BLACK))

board.turn = chess.WHITE

print("FEN:", board.fen())
print("Is White in check?", board.is_check())
print("Legal moves:", list(board.legal_moves))

# Find checkmate moves
for move in board.legal_moves:
    board.push(move)
    if board.is_checkmate():
        print(f"Checkmate move: {board.san(move)}")
    board.pop()
